title: Agent Skills Can Be Harmful: An Empirical Study of Skill-Induced Failures in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.11888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills are the de facto mechanism for extending LLM agents with reusable guidance. A skill can shape the agent's task execution, including planning, tool use, problem-solving, and validation. Prior work reported mixed results of agent skills: some skills improve task success rates, while others have no effect, increase token use and execution time, and even reduce success rates. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of skill-induced agent failures by attributing task failures and cost regressions to specific loaded skills. We introduce a differential analysis framework that attributes a failure or regression to a skill by comparing a target skill-guided run against a no-skill or semantically matched skill reference run that solves the same task, or solves it more cheaply. translated_title: 代理技能可能有害：LLM代理中技能诱发失败的实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11888v1 公告类型：新 摘要：代理技能是扩展LLM代理可重用指导的事实机制。技能可以塑造代理的任务执行，包括规划、工具使用、问题解决和验证。先前的工作报告了代理技能的混合结果：一些技能提高了任务成功率，而其他技能则没有效果，增加了令牌使用和执行时间，甚至降低了成功率。本文通过将任务失败和成本回归归因于特定的加载技能，对技能诱发的代理失败进行了全面分析。我们引入了一个差分分析框架，通过将目标技能引导的运行与无技能或语义匹配的技能参考运行（解决相同任务或以更低成本解决）进行比较，将失败或回归归因于技能。我们在SkillsBench和SWE-Skills-Bench上实例化此框架，产生了307个技能诱发的失败，包括125个功能性失败和182个效率性失败。
tldr: 本文通过差分分析框架，实证揭示了代理技能可能诱发任务失败和效率退化，导致功能性和效率性缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically reveals that agent skills can induce task failures and efficiency regressions, causing functional and efficiency defects through a differential analysis framework.
